about.label: About ODIN
about.intro: Our company is a national private-sector enterprise operating in Mongolia in the development of technology, artificial intelligence, and data-driven solutions. We are committed to bringing advanced technologies into practical use to support decision-making in government and business organizations and to improve productivity across key sectors of the economy.

analytics.description: Development of the virtual employee system is underway. A virtual employee is a software solution based on artificial intelligence (AI), trained on an organization's internal data, and capable of answering human questions, preparing reports and conclusions, issuing alerts, and performing automated response actions.
